title: Add a keyboard shortcut to focus the latest notifications that arrived
line: A new "Focus Latest Notification" shortcut lets you reply to or act on the newest notification popup without the mouse.
explanation: Notification popups never take keyboard focus by themselves, and there was no global shortcut to give it to them, so buttons and the inline reply field could only be used by clicking. Plasma's notification shortcuts were only "Toggle do not disturb" and "Clear Notification History". The change adds a third global shortcut, "Focus Latest Notification" (no default key, like the other two), that activates the newest visible popup: if it has an inline reply it opens the reply field, otherwise it focuses the popup's first control so Tab/Space work. A focused popup doesn't time out, and Escape hides it (into history, like a timeout), returning focus to the previous window.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: add a shortcut to focus the latest notification

Popups could only be used with the mouse, so replying to a message meant
leaving the keyboard. A new global shortcut focuses the newest popup and
starts its inline reply if it has one; Escape hides the focused popup.

BUG: 439893

media.caption: Master: a chat notification with Reply arrives while Konsole is focused; there is no shortcut to reach it, the reply can only be started with the mouse.
With the fix: pressing the new shortcut (set to Meta+Alt+N for the test) opens the reply field of the newest popup with keyboard focus; the reply is typed without touching the mouse, Enter sends it.
